articles.title: TVS Family Partition Suit: What Is Lakshmi Venu Seeking? Exclusive With C Aryama Sundaram
articles.description: The TVS family is facing a legal dispute over the partition of joint family assets, with Dr Lakshmi Venu approaching the Madras High Court seeking her rightful share in the family property. The suit follows a partition notice sent to her father, Venu Srinivasan, on 16 November 2026, after efforts to reach an amicable resolution failed. Dr Lakshmi Venu has also sought access to documents and information relating to the family assets, which she says have been consistently withheld despite multiple requests. In an exclusive conversation with Business Today, C Aryama Sundaram, counsel for Dr Lakshmi Venu, discusses the legal case, the demand for partition, the rights being asserted and the issues at the heart of the family dispute. The suit concerns ownership of joint family assets and is not directed at the operations of any TVS company. Mrs Mallika Srinivasan has also publicly backed her daughter's right to an equal share in the family assets. What does the legal battle mean for the TVS family, and what happens next? Watch the exclusive conversation for more.

articles.title: 10 baby names inspired by Greek mythology
articles.description: Greek mythology has given us some rather memorable characters: powerful goddesses, daring heroes, celestial beings and creatures that have found their way into stories told for thousands of years. Their names have travelled just as far, moving from ancient myths into everyday use. Some carry a story of their own, while others offer a subtle nod to the world of the Greek gods. Here are 10 baby names inspired by Greek mythology, with a little history behind each one.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's daughter to inherit actress' USD 6.23 million estate
articles.description: Hayden Panettiere's estate has been valued at over USD 6.2 million, but she died without leaving a will. Her daughter, Kaya, is the sole beneficiary of the estate. Wladimir Klitschko, Kaya's father, has filed for court approval to manage the estate. This action aims to protect Kaya's inheritance until a permanent administrator is appointed. Panettiere passed away from an accidental overdose at the age of 36 in South Carolina.

articles.title: Why is Cris Collinsworth missing Sunday Night Football? NBC names Jason Garrett as his replacement for the Cleveland Browns vs. Las Vegas Raiders week 12 showdown
articles.description: Cris Collinsworth will be absent from this week's Sunday Night Football. Stepping in, Jason Garrett will join Mike Tirico for the matchup between the Browns and Raiders. Collinsworth is scheduled to return for the Thanksgiving game on November 26. NBC has yet to confirm any long-term adjustments to its Sunday Night Football commentary lineup. With his coaching expertise, Garrett's contribution may enhance the broadcast's analysis.
